messages.content: What is the difference between a model and an application?

A model maps inputs to outputs based on learned parameters. An AI application wraps the model with data handling, prompts, retrieval, business logic, user interfaces, security, monitoring, and deployment. A strong application often depends as much on those systems as on the model choice.
What is a good stopping point for fine-tuning?

Stop when held-out performance meets your target and additional training no longer improves useful behavior, or when validation performance starts degrading. Compare checkpoints on the same test suite and inspect real failures; do not select a checkpoint solely because it has the lowest training loss.
What is overfitting?

Overfitting happens when a model learns the training examples too closely and fails to generalize to new inputs. Reduce it with varied examples, validation data, suitable training duration, and regularization where appropriate.
How do I write a useful project objective?

State the problem, the intended user, the capability being built, and the measurable outcome. Avoid vague phrases such as 'use AI to make things better.' A useful objective makes it possible to decide whether the project succeeded.
What is QLoRA?

QLoRA combines quantized base-model weights with trainable LoRA adapters. It can make fine-tuning larger models possible on more limited hardware, though actual memory needs still depend on sequence length, batch size, optimizer, and implementation.
How do I choose a chunk size for RAG?

There is no universal best chunk size. Start with a moderate size such as 500–800 tokens and some overlap, then evaluate retrieval quality on real questions. Keep chunks aligned with document structure and avoid splitting important tables, code, or definitions unnecessarily.
What is the difference between a prompt template and an f-string?

An f-string is Python string interpolation. A prompt template is a reusable structure designed to accept variables and can include framework-specific validation or message roles. Use f-strings for simple local formatting and prompt templates when building reusable model workflows.
What does CORS do?

CORS is a browser security mechanism that controls which origins may make cross-origin requests to a server. In FastAPI, configure allowed frontend origins explicitly. Avoid allowing every origin with credentials in production.
What should an AI engineer portfolio demonstrate?

Show that you can prepare data, choose a suitable model, integrate it into a reliable application, evaluate quality, handle failures, manage latency and cost, and deploy it. One strong end-to-end project with evidence is more convincing than a collection of copied notebooks.
Bro, which format should my fine-tuning dataset use?

Use JSONL for chat fine-tuning when your training framework supports message-based examples. Each line should be one valid JSON object, usually with a messages array containing user and assistant turns. Keep each record on one line and validate the file before training.
What are training, validation, and test sets?

Training data updates the model weights. Validation data helps choose settings and detect overfitting during development. Test data is held back until final evaluation so it gives a less biased estimate of performance on unseen examples.
How do I create a small dataset from my own chats?

Export the conversations you are allowed to use, remove secrets and unrelated personal details, and turn high-quality exchanges into consistent examples. Preserve the user's real question and a helpful answer, deduplicate near-identical records, and check the result for correctness before training.
